custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Ethereum block 26197390, all immediate positions are onchain USDC lending claims and borrowers reuse the lent USDC. That local custody fact does not establish fully onchain custody for the complete economic book. cbBTC/WBTC-secured lending is 62.7869% of NAV; additional claims depend on PT-reUSD, PT-USDat, Wildcat unsecured debt-token collateral and 3Jane USD3. Their full downstream asset custody and legal priority were not established. The material custodial BTC collateral layer alongside onchain positions makes the whole-book custodyModel mixed. Circle reserve custody remains a separate inherited exposure. The curator's terms disclaim custody of depositor shares, financial protection and guaranteed withdrawal timing; they establish neither legal segregation nor bankruptcy remoteness. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
